user_statement: 批准发送问题文本用于检索实体抽取。
authorized_operation: Send LoCoMo QA question text to the configured external model for retrieval-time question Entity extraction.
runtime_boundary: Question-derived Entities may be used only to query the existing conversation-built Entity-Memory graph.
warm_cache_policy: Warm replay must reuse the completed question Entity cache and make zero new provider requests.
